subject: anatomy
title: Pelvic walls, pelvic floor and perineum: high-yield anatomy

steps.tx: The **pelvic floor** is formed mainly by the pelvic diaphragm. It is made of levator ani and coccygeus. It separates the pelvic cavity above from the perineum below. The urethra, anal canal and, in females, the vagina pass through it.
steps.say: The pelvic floor is formed mainly by the pelvic diaphragm, made of levator ani and coccygeus. It separates the pelvic cavity above from the perineum below. The urethra, anal canal and, in females, the vagina pass through it.

rows: Sphincter urethrae and deep transverse perineal muscles
Floor of the deep perineal pouch

steps.tx: The **urogenital diaphragm** is a musculo-fascial sheet across the pubic arch. It lies between the pelvic cavity and the anterior part of the pelvic outlet. Its muscles get their motor supply from the perineal branch of the pudendal nerve. The urethra pierces it in both sexes, and the vagina does so in females.
steps.say: The urogenital diaphragm is a musculo-fascial sheet across the pubic arch. It lies between the pelvic cavity and the front of the pelvic outlet. Its muscles are supplied by the perineal branch of the pudendal nerve. The urethra pierces it in both sexes, and in females the vagina passes through as well.

vis.alt: Diamond-shaped perineum divided by a line between the ischial tuberosities into the anterior urogenital triangle and the posterior anal triangle, bounded by pubic symphysis, ischiopubic rami, ischial tuberosities, sacrotuberous ligaments and coccyx.
vis.caption: A transverse line through the ischial tuberosities splits the diamond into urogenital and anal triangles.

steps.tx: The **ischioanal fossa** lies in the anal triangle. It is a fat-filled space with the inferior rectal vessels inside it. Its lateral wall is the obturator internus with its fascia. Its medial wall is the external anal sphincter and levator ani. Bleeding here can track into a large swelling, so rupture of its vessels matters clinically.
steps.say: The ischioanal fossa lies in the anal triangle and is filled with fat. Its lateral wall is the obturator internus with its fascia. Its medial wall is the external anal sphincter and levator ani. It contains the inferior rectal vessels, so bleeding from them can be significant.

steps.tx: The **pudendal nerve** arises from S2 to S4. It leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen and re-enters through the lesser sciatic foramen. It runs in the **pudendal canal** with the internal pudendal vessels. It gives the inferior anal nerve, the perineal nerve and the dorsal nerve of the penis or clitoris. Pain below the pectinate line is carried by its inferior rectal branch.
steps.say: The pudendal nerve arises from S2 to S4. It leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen and re-enters through the lesser sciatic foramen. It runs in the pudendal canal with the internal pudendal vessels. Pain below the pectinate line is carried by its inferior rectal branch.

steps.tx: The **anal canal** is split by the **pectinate line**. Above it, the mucosa is supplied by visceral nerves and is insensitive to pain. Below it, the skin is supplied by somatic nerves and is painful. External haemorrhoids lie below this line, which explains their pain. The anorectal ring is the main continence structure. It is formed by the internal sphincter, the deep external sphincter and puborectalis.
steps.say: The anal canal is divided by the pectinate line. Above it the mucosa is insensitive to pain. Below it the skin is painful. External haemorrhoids lie below the line, which explains their pain. The anorectal ring, made of the internal sphincter, deep external sphincter and puborectalis, is the main continence structure.

steps.tx: Study the **perineal muscles** in inferior view. The **perineal body** is the midline point where bulbospongiosus, the transverse perineal muscles and the external anal sphincter meet. In the female the paired bulbospongiosus lies beside the vaginal opening. This original schematic names every muscle that converges here.

In the female the paired bulbospongiosus lies beside the vaginal opening. This original schematic names every muscle that converges here.
